name: daily_missions
description: BD2 daily/weekly mission rewards — ported from BD2-AUTO src/auto_tasks/Default/tasks/daily_missions.py. Click 'missions' → 'claim all' (daily) → back → 'weekly' → 'claim all' (weekly) → back → ESC to main. ROIs at 1920x1080 base resolution. (pending e2e verification — R37-P2 C2 PoC covers login only)

metadata.goal: Claim BD2 daily and weekly mission rewards

nodes.comment: Click the '任务' (missions) button on the main menu bottom bar to open the missions panel
nodes.rationale: OCR is used instead of template matching because the button text is stable across UI themes and resolutions, while button appearance may vary

nodes.comment: Wait for the '每日任务' (daily tasks) tab label to appear, confirming the missions panel has loaded
Click '全部获得' (claim all) button to collect all daily mission rewards
nodes.rationale: Claim-all button is preferred over per-mission claiming to minimize clicks and reduce OCR cycles

nodes.comment: Wait 2s for reward claim animation and UI update to settle before navigating back
Click the back button (template '返回键1.png') to return from daily missions view to the missions tab selector
Wait 1.5s for back-navigation transition animation to complete before clicking the weekly tab
Click the '每周任务' (weekly tasks) tab label to switch from daily to weekly missions view
Wait 2s for the weekly tasks tab content to load after tab switch
nodes.rationale: Fixed wait is used instead of OCR wait because the weekly tab does not show a distinct text label that differs from the tab selector

nodes.comment: Click '全部获得' (claim all) button to collect all weekly mission rewards
Wait 2s for reward claim animation to settle before navigating back
Click the back button to return from weekly missions view to the main menu
Wait 1.5s for back-navigation transition before pressing ESC
Press ESC to close any remaining missions overlay and return to the game main menu
Wait for the main menu template ('主界面.png') to appear, confirming successful return to the main screen
nodes.rationale: Template wait at the end provides a synchronization point — if this node fails, the pipeline did not return to main menu correctly and subsequent tasks in a chain should not proceed
